title: Nvidia clarifies when it will — and won’t — keep financing neoclouds
lede: Interim CEO Colette Kress said Nvidia's data center loan guarantees only start once a customer has raised its own financing and installed Nvidia hardware, and fall away if the build stalls.

points: Nvidia reported third-quarter net income of $64.9 billion, up from $59.7 billion the quarter before.
Its largest guarantee is a $105 billion backstop for OpenAI's PORTS-Pike campus in Ohio, in exchange for exclusive use of Nvidia equipment.
Kress, then CFO, reportedly cut that backstop from $250 billion.
She called the conditions a clarification of existing terms rather than a new policy, though they had never been public.
Land, power and building shells remain a priority for support, but Nvidia will be choosier about which companies it helps finance.

sections.text: Nvidia money has helped fund the GPU capacity AI builders rent; Kress is signalling that Huang-era open-handed deals are giving way to conditional, more selective support for neoclouds.
